CREATE TABLE features_gb_imbalance_price (
  model_id STRING,
  feature_set_version INT,
  prediction_key STRING,
  delivery_start TIMESTAMP(3),
  `as_of` TIMESTAMP(3),
  features ROW<generation_mw DOUBLE, price_gbp_mwh DOUBLE>
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'features.gb-imbalance-price.v1',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'redpanda-0.redpanda.redpanda.svc.cluster.local:9093',
  'format' = 'json'
);
INSERT INTO features_gb_imbalance_price SELECT 'gb-imbalance-price' AS model_id, 1 AS feature_set_version, CONCAT('FUEL|', f.fuel_type, '|', DATE_FORMAT(f.event_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss''Z''')) AS prediction_key, f.event_time AS delivery_start, f.event_time AS `as_of`, ROW(f.generation_mw, p.price_gbp_mwh) AS features FROM elexon_fuelinst AS f LEFT JOIN elexon_system_price AS p ON p.event_time = f.event_time
